project_overview: This Vue.js application appears to manage user interactions and data presentation, likely within an educational or services domain. The codebase demonstrates a clear separation of concerns with dedicated components for various functionalities, including exam submissions, fee details, and user profiles. The application utilizes routing to navigate between these components, suggesting a user-centric design.  The dependency graph indicates a focus on dynamic content rendering and component reuse.

macro_trends.title: Potential UI/UX Fragility - Accessibility Concerns
macro_trends.description: Multiple Vue files ('ApplicationServices.vue', 'ExamFormSubmission.vue', 'iLikeCourses.vue', 'SelectedApplicationService.vue') have identified accessibility issues within the confirmed issues summary. This suggests a need for greater emphasis on accessibility testing and UI design best practices throughout the presentation layer. Potential for inconsistent styling and usability issues.

macro_trends.title: Router Dependence – Potential Route Bloat
macro_trends.description: A significant number of Vue files are linked via Router navigation. This creates tight coupling and may indicate an opportunity to refactor components with independent routing needs or centralize routing logic to reduce duplication and improve maintainability. Consideration needed for performance implications.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission Workflow
key_workflows.description: The flow starts with the user interacting with 'ExamFormSubmission.vue', which likely triggers data processing and validation, then potentially interacts with 'Transactions.vue' for data persistence. Navigation to 'ResultPage.vue' or 'HallTicketPage.vue' follows the submission.

key_workflows.name: User Profile Interaction
key_workflows.description: User navigation to various dashboards ('iLikeCourses.vue', 'iLikeDashboard.vue', 'iLikeLanding.vue') suggests a user-centric design. The flow could potentially be streamlined by centralizing user profile data management.
